summary: Preview an entry by signed token
description: The entry's **current** state in any status (draft, review, archived…) behind a token from staff `POST content/entries/<uid>/preview/` (captured as `public_content_preview_token`). Same flat shape plus `meta.preview: true`. Never cached: `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. Expired (TTL `BLOG_PREVIEW_TTL_SECONDS`, default 1 h) → 410 `link_expired`; tampered → 403 `signature_invalid`; entry deleted → 404 `entry_not_found`.

data.insights: A 3 kW system in Kochi generates roughly 12 units a day, enough for a typical 2BHK home.

summary: List published entries of a collection
description: The legacy CMS Strapi-v5-flat contract: `{data: [...], meta: {pagination}}` with PUBLISHED entries of an **active** collection only (unknown or inactive → 404 `collection_not_found`). Filters `filters[<field>][<op>]` on slug, title, documentId, isFeatured, sortOrder, publishedOn, publishedAt, updatedAt, readTime with $eq $eqi $in $contains $ne $null $gt $gte $lt $lte (unknown fields/ops ignored; an unparseable value → 400 `invalid_filter`); `sort[n]=field[:asc|desc]`; `pagination[page]`, `pagination[pageSize]` (25, clamped 1…200). A lone `filters[slug][$eq]` that only matches an active alias returns the entry with `meta.redirect`. Cached server-side 300 s in the version-keyed response cache (keyed by path + query string **as sent**; any Studio save bumps it), `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60`, `ETag` (send `If-None-Match` → 304) and `X-Cache: HIT|MISS`.

Rich text (`summary`, `introduction`, RICH_TEXT/TABLE block `data`) is a Strapi-blocks array.
